mapper.select: SELECT last_id FROM dimension_user_read WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = #{type}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_user_read (user_id, type, last_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{lastId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_id = GREATEST(last_id, #{lastId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_notice WHERE id > #{sinceId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(c.id), 0) FROM dimension_comment c WHERE c.content LIKE CONCAT('%@', #{nickname}, '%') AND c.user_id != #{userId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(i.id), 0) FROM dimension_image i INNER JOIN dimension_follow f ON f.followed_user_id = i.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND i.status = 1
